official_measurement_examples.name: Designation separation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Archaeological interest is not limited to scheduled monuments; non-designated remains can be relevant to planning decisions.

official_measurement_examples.name: HER limitation
official_measurement_examples.fact: A historic environment record is an evidence source and does not prove absence of archaeology where no record is present.

official_measurement_examples.name: Desk study distinction
official_measurement_examples.fact: Desk-based assessment is not equivalent to intrusive field evaluation or excavation evidence.

official_measurement_examples.name: Planning condition distinction
official_measurement_examples.fact: An archaeological planning condition is not Scheduled Monument Consent and does not replace any separate statutory consent.

official_measurement_examples.name: Mitigation separation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Recording preservation or excavation mitigation does not itself grant planning permission.

official_measurement_examples.name: 2026 currentity
official_measurement_examples.fact: Historic England's planning-system page was updated 8 May 2026 and GLAAS published updated developer/planner archaeology guidance in February 2026.

official_measurement_examples.name: Geometry limitation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Designation or HER geometry is not a survey-grade excavation boundary and must not be used as exact buildable-area geometry.

official_measurement_examples.name: Parcel limitation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Archaeological evidence does not establish ownership access rights planning permission or final development yield.

core_rules: archaeology is not limited to scheduled monuments
no designation is not proof of no archaeology
HER absence is not proof of absence
desk assessment is not intrusive evaluation
field evaluation is not full excavation
planning condition is not Scheduled Monument Consent
recorded archaeology does not establish ownership
designation geometry is not excavation geometry
historic evidence must retain date and source
archaeology does not calculate development yield
no parcel archaeology clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
source_verification_note: Historic England, GOV.UK and legislation sources checked 2026-07-26. May 2026 planning-system and February 2026 GLAAS currentity retained; designated/non-designated and desk/field/consent distinctions enforced; no parcel promotion.
